title: Your wealth, another’s importance
odia:
ତୋହରି ଧନ ତୋତେ ଦେଇ
ମଝିରେ ମଧ୍ୟସ୍ଥି ବୋଲାଇ।
literal_meaning: Giving you your own wealth, and getting called the intermediary in between.
meaning_odia: ତୁମରି ଧନ ତୁମକୁ ଦେଇ ଜଣେ ମଝିରେ ମଧ୍ୟସ୍ଥି ବୋଲାଉଛନ୍ତି। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାରେ, ନିଜର କିଛି ଦେବା ବଦଳରେ ଅନ୍ୟର ସମ୍ପଦ ପହଞ୍ଚାଇ ନିଜ ଭୂମିକାର ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦେଖାଇବାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ବିଦ୍ରୂପ କରାଯାଇଛି। ଧନର ମାଲିକ ଓ ତାହା ପାଉଥିବା ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି ଏକା ହୋଇଥିବାରୁ ଏହି ବିରୋଧଟି ସ୍ପଷ୍ଟ ହୁଏ।
explanation: The money already belongs to the person receiving it, yet someone between owner and receipt acquires the title of intermediary. Our editorial reading hears a criticism of making one’s role seem important through someone else’s resources. The verse does not specify a fee, theft or the circumstances of the transfer.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A volunteer passes a club member their own deposited funds, then speaks as though this were a personal favour. Another member recalls the saying about giving someone their own wealth.
cultural_context: ତୋହରି and ତୋତେ connect ownership and receipt to the same person. Against that direct connection, ମଝିରେ and ମଧ୍ୟସ୍ଥି repeatedly place another figure in the middle.
